event_provenance_summary.scientific_rationale: No event is classified as 'VERIFIED_POINT_IN_TIME' because exact sub-second packet capture logs from the primary publisher web servers at the instant of public dissemination are not archived. Instead, all 3 events are classified as 'BOUNDED_WITH_EVIDENCE' because their nominal release time, legal dissemination mechanics, wire transmission lockup protocols, and public web dissemination delays are bounded by documented empirical evidence [t_min, t_max].

provenance_tier_definitions.VERIFIED_POINT_IN_TIME: Cryptographically or network-packet timestamped receipt at sub-second precision by an independent authoritative monitor.
provenance_tier_definitions.BOUNDED_WITH_EVIDENCE: Earliest and latest machine availability bounded by documented dissemination rules, embargo release logs, or HTTP server logs with empirical [t_min, t_max].
provenance_tier_definitions.ASSUMED_LATENCY: Nominal time known, but delay is estimated without empirical server or wire measurement.
provenance_tier_definitions.DATE_ONLY: Calendar vintage date known, but intraday publication hour/minute/second is unrecorded or unavailable.
provenance_tier_definitions.UNVERIFIABLE: Neither primary publication record nor contemporaneous corroboration can be validated.

audited_events.title: US Bureau of Labor Statistics May 2022 Consumer Price Index Release
audited_events.source_agency: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), Department of Labor

publication_time.legal_statutory_basis: BLS News Release Schedule published under DOL Statistical Policy Directive

content_verification.original_excerpt: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 1.0 percent in May on a seasonally adjusted basis after rising 0.3 percent in April, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 8.6 percent before seasonal adjustment.

availability_evidence.empirical_evidence_basis: Primary news agencies (Bloomberg News, Reuters, Dow Jones) receive high-speed line transmission inside the Department of Labor lockup facility precisely at 08:30:00.000 EDT. Wire headline alerts appear on terminals within 1-5 seconds. Public web server distribution across bls.gov and public RSS dissemination experiences cache propagation and network transit times between 15 and 120 seconds.
availability_evidence.alfred_vintage_distinction: ALFRED CPIAUCSL vintage date is 2022-06-10 (calendar date). ALFRED does not record intraday publication seconds; intraday timing is established strictly by BLS embargo protocol at 12:30:00 UTC.

unverified_assumptions: Assumed that high-frequency market participants acted upon news wire dissemination within [15s, 60s] rather than waiting for full PDF rendering.
Assumed that no illicit pre-embargo leak occurred prior to 12:30:00 UTC (no abnormal BTC volume surge detected prior to 12:30 UTC).

official_published_actual.metric: CPI-U All Items 12-Month Percentage Change (Year-over-Year, Unadjusted)
official_published_actual.source: BLS News Release USDL-22-1111 Table A
official_published_actual.notes: Headline unadjusted CPI-U is immutable; seasonal factors are updated annually but historical unadjusted series is permanent.

contemporaneous_market_consensus.retrospective_consensus_restatement_risk: NONE (Survey captured contemporaneously prior to 12:30:00 UTC release)

audited_events.title: Federal Reserve FOMC 75 bps Rate Increase Statement

publication_time.legal_statutory_basis: Federal Open Market Committee Meeting Schedule and Official Statement Release

content_verification.original_excerpt: The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run. In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent and anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate.
content_verification.full_source_document_identifier: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy Press Release 2022-06-15 (monetary20220615a.htm)

availability_evidence.empirical_evidence_basis: Federal Reserve website publication push and press room transmission occur simultaneously at 14:00:00 EDT. Financial news services publish instant headlines within 5-10 seconds. Web edge cache propagation across public networks completes within 90 seconds.
availability_evidence.alfred_vintage_distinction: ALFRED series DFEDTARMD shows vintage date 2022-06-15. The exact statement timestamp is 18:00:00 UTC.

unverified_assumptions: Assumed that public market participants received website push between 10s and 90s.
Separated the 14:00:00 EDT statement release from the subsequent 14:30:00 EDT press conference (which introduced separate verbal volatility).

official_published_actual.metric: Federal Funds Target Range Upper Limit
official_published_actual.source: Federal Reserve Board of Governors Official Press Release
official_published_actual.notes: FOMC policy statements are primary statutory records; never revised retrospectively.

publication_time.legal_statutory_basis: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 Section 19(b)(2) Accelerated Approval Order

content_verification.original_excerpt: SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION (Release No. 34-99306; File Nos. SR-NYSEARCA-2021-90; SR-BITO-2023; etc.) Order Granting Accelerated Approval of Proposed Rule Changes, as Modified by Amendments Thereto, to List and Trade Shares of the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust, the Bitwise Bitcoin ETF, the Hashdex Bitcoin ETF, the iShares Bitcoin Trust, the Valkyrie Bitcoin Fund, the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF, the Invesco Galaxy Bitcoin ETF, the VanEck Bitcoin Trust, the WisdomTree Bitcoin Fund, the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Trust, and the Franklin Bitcoin ETF.

availability_evidence.empirical_evidence_basis: The official PDF approval order was first uploaded to sec.gov between 15:45 and 15:50 EST (20:45-20:50 UTC). Initial traffic spikes caused immediate server load issues resulting in HTTP 404/503 errors for users attempting to load the direct PDF link. First confirmed successful downloads by market reporters occurred at 20:46 UTC. Global CDN edge synchronization stabilized by 20:52 UTC.
availability_evidence.alfred_vintage_distinction: SEC regulatory orders are legal administrative decisions not tracked by macroeconomic vintage databases. Dissemination timing is established by SEC EDGAR publication records and web archive timestamps.

unverified_assumptions: Assumed that initial direct link distribution via social media/wire terminals occurred at 20:46:00 UTC.
Assumed that general market participants could reliably verify authenticity by 20:52:00 UTC given the false hack announcement on Jan 9.

official_published_actual.notes: Final regulatory order granting omnibus approval for all 11 pending 19b-4 rule filings.
